# The IT XP

> A podcast for IT professionals, hosted by Chuck Betancourt — pulling back the curtain on what it's really like to work in Information Technology. Career insights, real talk, and hard-won experience points, produced by COTIB LLC.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage (/)](https://www.theitxp.com/): Latest podcast episodes and videos.
- [Episodes (/episodes)](https://www.theitxp.com/episodes): All episodes, organized by season. Individual episodes live at /<episode-slug>.
- [About (/about)](https://www.theitxp.com/about): About the show and its focus on IT careers, cloud, and on-premises technology work.
- [Contact (/contact)](https://www.theitxp.com/contact): Collaboration, guest, and co-host inquiries.
